after.scope: stat only; inaccessible/reparse targets excluded; accessible lower bound

known_limitations: Qualified independent-body linear static TET4/TET10 scope; one valid solid per definition; rigid placement only.
Ambiguous face identity blocks analysis and requires deliberate native review/reassignment.
Twenty-cycle measurements do not prove leak-free operation; Undo retains bounded engineering snapshots.
Repository footprint is an accessible lower bound; inaccessible legacy paths and reparse targets are excluded.
resolved_failures: Early lifecycle harness used Godot-only process tracking; replaced with Windows handles and rerun.
STEP preview wrote canonical geometry metadata through a compatibility view; replaced with validated document mutation.
Unattached imported-STEP topology pickers leaked; freed and repeated teardown verified.
Empty unresolved geometry caused camera fitting errors; null geometry is skipped.
Historical CAD24 ambiguous face names blocked safely; native review and explicit reassignment added to its runner.
Per-frame progress grew the transient Workbench console; bounded paragraphs/characters and throttled updates qualified through a fresh 20-cycle run.
